title: Mar bar Yishmael
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin cites him challenging Rav Nachman in the Tefillat HaShachar chapter. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2414&lang=en) says, “I did not find him.” Hyman’s friend, the rabbinic scholar who wrote Nachal Eden, suggests that Yuchasin read Mar bar Yishmael where [Berakhot 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.29a.16) has Rabbah bar Shmuel challenging Rav Nachman.

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rabbah bar Shmuel as the objector who proposes a separate fourth blessing. Heilprin’s linked entry records the chapter and says he did not find Mar bar Yishmael there. The proposed Yuchasin reading belongs to the author of Nachal Eden, quoted by Hyman.
